patch_description: The strongest prior configuration used a 0.85/0.15 direct-demand blend and stronger two-hop support; the current program shifts to 0.75/0.25 and weaker path support. This proposal uses an intermediate 0.80/0.20 blend and path strength 0.53, aiming to retain direct-link preference while giving useful indirect routes more influence. It keeps the existing node-pressure and edge-pressure discounts, which temper path rewards through busy nodes and links. The number of quadratic terms remains within the required bound.
